named_features_attack_count_kind_check.name: named_features_attack_count_kind_check
named_features_attack_count_kind_check.value: effect_attack_count IS NULL OR effect_kind IS 'extra_attack'

named_features_weapon_scope_kind_check.name: named_features_weapon_scope_kind_check
named_features_weapon_scope_kind_check.value: effect_weapon_scope IS NULL OR effect_kind IS 'extra_attack'

named_features_extra_attack_payload_chec.name: named_features_extra_attack_payload_check
named_features_extra_attack_payload_chec.value: effect_kind IS NOT 'extra_attack' OR (effect_attack_count IS NOT NULL AND effect_weapon_scope IS NOT NULL)

subclass_features_attack_count_kind_chec.name: subclass_features_attack_count_kind_check
subclass_features_attack_count_kind_chec.value: effect_attack_count IS NULL OR effect_kind IS 'extra_attack'

subclass_features_weapon_scope_kind_chec.name: subclass_features_weapon_scope_kind_check
subclass_features_weapon_scope_kind_chec.value: effect_weapon_scope IS NULL OR effect_kind IS 'extra_attack'

subclass_features_extra_attack_payload_c.name: subclass_features_extra_attack_payload_check
subclass_features_extra_attack_payload_c.value: effect_kind IS NOT 'extra_attack' OR (effect_attack_count IS NOT NULL AND effect_weapon_scope IS NOT NULL)

spell_versions_level_check.name: spell_versions_level_check
spell_versions_level_check.value: provenance IS 'placeholder' OR level BETWEEN 0 AND 9

spell_versions_range_feet_check.name: spell_versions_range_feet_check
spell_versions_range_feet_check.value:
(`range_feet` IS NULL OR (typeof(`range_feet`) = 'integer' AND `range_feet` >= 0))
        AND (`range_feet` IS NULL OR `range_kind` IS 'ranged')

spell_versions_area_check.name: spell_versions_area_check
spell_versions_area_check.value:
(`area_feet` IS NULL OR (typeof(`area_feet`) = 'integer' AND `area_feet` >= 1))
        AND ((`area_shape` IS NULL) = (`area_feet` IS NULL))

spell_versions_material_cost_check.name: spell_versions_material_cost_check
spell_versions_material_cost_check.value:
(`material_cost_copper` IS NULL OR (typeof(`material_cost_copper`) = 'integer' AND `material_cost_copper` >= 0))
        AND (`material_cost_kind` IS NULL OR `material_cost_kind` IN ('exact', 'minimum'))
        AND ((`material_cost_copper` IS NULL) = (`material_cost_kind` IS NULL))

characters_ability_scores_check.name: characters_ability_scores_check
characters_ability_scores_check.value:
strength BETWEEN 1 AND 30
      AND dexterity BETWEEN 1 AND 30
      AND constitution BETWEEN 1 AND 30
      AND intelligence BETWEEN 1 AND 30
      AND wisdom BETWEEN 1 AND 30
      AND charisma BETWEEN 1 AND 30

spell_slots_exclusive_assignment_check.name: spell_slots_exclusive_assignment_check
spell_slots_exclusive_assignment_check.value: fixed_spell_version_id IS NULL OR current_spell_version_id IS NULL

spell_selection_slots_level_window_check.name: spell_selection_slots_level_window_check
spell_selection_slots_level_window_check.value:
spell_level_min BETWEEN 0 AND 9
        AND spell_level_max BETWEEN 0 AND 9
        AND spell_level_min <= spell_level_max

background_equipment_items_payload_check.name: background_equipment_items_payload_check
background_equipment_items_payload_check.value:
CASE `item_kind`
        WHEN 'weapon' THEN `weapon_template_id` IS NOT NULL
          AND `armor_template_id` IS NULL
        WHEN 'armor' THEN `armor_template_id` IS NOT NULL
          AND `weapon_template_id` IS NULL
        ELSE `weapon_template_id` IS NULL AND `armor_template_id` IS NULL
      END

character_effects_damage_type_kind_check.name: character_effects_damage_type_kind_check
character_effects_damage_type_kind_check.value: damage_type IS NULL OR effect_kind IS 'damage_resistance'

character_effects_hit_points_kind_check.name: character_effects_hit_points_kind_check
character_effects_hit_points_kind_check.value: (hit_points_flat IS NULL AND hit_points_per_level IS NULL) OR effect_kind IS 'hp_modifier'

character_effects_speed_kind_check.name: character_effects_speed_kind_check
character_effects_speed_kind_check.value: speed_bonus_feet IS NULL OR effect_kind IS 'speed'

character_effects_hp_modifier_payload_ch.name: character_effects_hp_modifier_payload_check
character_effects_hp_modifier_payload_ch.value: effect_kind IS NOT 'hp_modifier' OR hit_points_flat IS NOT NULL OR hit_points_per_level IS NOT NULL

character_effects_speed_payload_check.name: character_effects_speed_payload_check
character_effects_speed_payload_check.value: effect_kind IS NOT 'speed' OR speed_bonus_feet IS NOT NULL

species_template_trait_effects_damage_ty.name: species_template_trait_effects_damage_type_kind_check
species_template_trait_effects_damage_ty.value: damage_type IS NULL OR effect_kind IS 'damage_resistance'

species_template_trait_effects_hit_point.name: species_template_trait_effects_hit_points_kind_check
species_template_trait_effects_hit_point.value: (hit_points_flat IS NULL AND hit_points_per_level IS NULL) OR effect_kind IS 'hp_modifier'

species_template_trait_effects_speed_kin.name: species_template_trait_effects_speed_kind_check
species_template_trait_effects_speed_kin.value: speed_bonus_feet IS NULL OR effect_kind IS 'speed'

species_template_trait_effects_hp_modifi.name: species_template_trait_effects_hp_modifier_payload_check
species_template_trait_effects_hp_modifi.value: effect_kind IS NOT 'hp_modifier' OR hit_points_flat IS NOT NULL OR hit_points_per_level IS NOT NULL

species_template_trait_effects_speed_pay.name: species_template_trait_effects_speed_payload_check
species_template_trait_effects_speed_pay.value: effect_kind IS NOT 'speed' OR speed_bonus_feet IS NOT NULL

class_equipment_items_payload_check.name: class_equipment_items_payload_check
class_equipment_items_payload_check.value:
CASE `item_kind`
        WHEN 'weapon' THEN `weapon_template_id` IS NOT NULL
          AND `armor_template_id` IS NULL
        WHEN 'armor' THEN `armor_template_id` IS NOT NULL
          AND `weapon_template_id` IS NULL
        ELSE `weapon_template_id` IS NULL AND `armor_template_id` IS NULL
      END

armor_templates_dex_bonus_max_check.name: armor_templates_dex_bonus_max_check
armor_templates_dex_bonus_max_check.value: (`dex_bonus` = 'capped') = (`dex_bonus_max` IS NOT NULL) AND (`dex_bonus_max` IS NULL OR (typeof(`dex_bonus_max`) = 'integer' AND `dex_bonus_max` >= 0))

class_extra_attack_grants_check.name: class_extra_attack_grants_check
class_extra_attack_grants_check.value: class_level BETWEEN 1 AND 20 AND typeof(`attack_count`) = 'integer' AND `attack_count` >= 2

class_martial_arts_dice_check.name: class_martial_arts_dice_check
class_martial_arts_dice_check.value: class_level BETWEEN 1 AND 20 AND typeof(`martial_arts_die`) = 'integer' AND `martial_arts_die` IN (6, 8, 10, 12)

class_sheet_traits_check.name: class_sheet_traits_check
class_sheet_traits_check.value: typeof(`hit_die`) = 'integer' AND `hit_die` IN (6, 8, 10, 12) AND typeof(`skill_choice_count`) = 'integer' AND `skill_choice_count` >= 1

class_sheet_traits_multiclass_skill_choi.name: class_sheet_traits_multiclass_skill_choice_check
class_sheet_traits_multiclass_skill_choi.value: typeof(`multiclass_skill_choice_count`) = 'integer' AND ((`multiclass_skill_choice_pool` IN ('none') AND `multiclass_skill_choice_count` = 0) OR (`multiclass_skill_choice_pool` IN ('class_list', 'any') AND `multiclass_skill_choice_count` >= 1))

character_armor_dex_bonus_max_check.name: character_armor_dex_bonus_max_check
character_armor_dex_bonus_max_check.value: (`dex_bonus` = 'capped') = (`dex_bonus_max` IS NOT NULL) AND (`dex_bonus_max` IS NULL OR (typeof(`dex_bonus_max`) = 'integer' AND `dex_bonus_max` >= 0))

character_hit_point_rolls_check.name: character_hit_point_rolls_check
character_hit_point_rolls_check.value: `class_level` BETWEEN 1 AND 20 AND typeof(`rolled_value`) = 'integer' AND `rolled_value` >= 1 AND `rolled_value` <= 12

character_weapons_damage_check.name: character_weapons_damage_check
character_weapons_damage_check.value:
(
        (damage_kind = 'dice' AND damage_dice IS NOT NULL AND damage_flat IS NULL AND damage_custom IS NULL)
        OR (damage_kind = 'flat' AND damage_dice IS NULL AND damage_flat IS NOT NULL AND damage_flat >= 0 AND damage_custom IS NULL)
        OR (damage_kind = 'custom' AND damage_dice IS NULL AND damage_flat IS NULL AND damage_custom IS NOT NULL)
        OR (damage_kind = 'not_recorded' AND damage_dice IS NULL AND damage_flat IS NULL AND damage_custom IS NULL)
      )

character_weapons_versatile_damage_check.name: character_weapons_versatile_damage_check
character_weapons_versatile_damage_check.value:
(
        (versatile_damage_kind = 'dice' AND versatile_damage_dice IS NOT NULL AND versatile_damage_flat IS NULL AND versatile_damage_custom IS NULL)
        OR (versatile_damage_kind = 'flat' AND versatile_damage_dice IS NULL AND versatile_damage_flat IS NOT NULL AND versatile_damage_flat >= 0 AND versatile_damage_custom IS NULL)
        OR (versatile_damage_kind = 'custom' AND versatile_damage_dice IS NULL AND versatile_damage_flat IS NULL AND versatile_damage_custom IS NOT NULL)
        OR (versatile_damage_kind = 'not_applicable' AND versatile_damage_dice IS NULL AND versatile_damage_flat IS NULL AND versatile_damage_custom IS NULL)
      )

character_weapons_range_check.name: character_weapons_range_check
character_weapons_range_check.value:
(
        (range_near_feet IS NULL OR (typeof(range_near_feet) = 'integer' AND range_near_feet BETWEEN 0 AND 100000))
        AND (range_far_feet IS NULL OR (typeof(range_far_feet) = 'integer' AND range_far_feet BETWEEN 0 AND 100000))
        AND (
          (range_kind = 'none' AND range_near_feet IS NULL AND range_far_feet IS NULL)
          OR (range_kind = 'ranged' AND range_near_feet IS NOT NULL AND (range_far_feet IS NULL OR range_far_feet >= range_near_feet))
          OR (range_kind = 'legacy' AND range_far_feet IS NOT NULL AND (range_near_feet IS NULL OR range_far_feet < range_near_feet))
        )
      )

character_weapons_mastery_requires_prope.name: character_weapons_mastery_requires_property_check
character_weapons_mastery_requires_prope.value: mastery_selected = 0 OR mastery_property IS NOT NULL

class_weapon_mastery_counts_check.name: class_weapon_mastery_counts_check
class_weapon_mastery_counts_check.value: class_level BETWEEN 1 AND 20 AND typeof(`mastery_count`) = 'integer' AND `mastery_count` >= 0

weapon_templates_damage_check.name: weapon_templates_damage_check
weapon_templates_damage_check.value:
(
        (damage_kind = 'dice' AND damage_dice IS NOT NULL AND damage_flat IS NULL AND damage_custom IS NULL)
        OR (damage_kind = 'flat' AND damage_dice IS NULL AND damage_flat IS NOT NULL AND damage_flat >= 0 AND damage_custom IS NULL)
        OR (damage_kind = 'custom' AND damage_dice IS NULL AND damage_flat IS NULL AND damage_custom IS NOT NULL)
        OR (damage_kind = 'not_recorded' AND damage_dice IS NULL AND damage_flat IS NULL AND damage_custom IS NULL)
      )

weapon_templates_versatile_damage_check.name: weapon_templates_versatile_damage_check
weapon_templates_versatile_damage_check.value:
(
        (versatile_damage_kind = 'dice' AND versatile_damage_dice IS NOT NULL AND versatile_damage_flat IS NULL AND versatile_damage_custom IS NULL)
        OR (versatile_damage_kind = 'flat' AND versatile_damage_dice IS NULL AND versatile_damage_flat IS NOT NULL AND versatile_damage_flat >= 0 AND versatile_damage_custom IS NULL)
        OR (versatile_damage_kind = 'custom' AND versatile_damage_dice IS NULL AND versatile_damage_flat IS NULL AND versatile_damage_custom IS NOT NULL)
        OR (versatile_damage_kind = 'not_applicable' AND versatile_damage_dice IS NULL AND versatile_damage_flat IS NULL AND versatile_damage_custom IS NULL)
      )

weapon_templates_range_check.name: weapon_templates_range_check
weapon_templates_range_check.value:
(
        (range_near_feet IS NULL OR (typeof(range_near_feet) = 'integer' AND range_near_feet BETWEEN 0 AND 100000))
        AND (range_far_feet IS NULL OR (typeof(range_far_feet) = 'integer' AND range_far_feet BETWEEN 0 AND 100000))
        AND (
          (range_kind = 'none' AND range_near_feet IS NULL AND range_far_feet IS NULL)
          OR (range_kind = 'ranged' AND range_near_feet IS NOT NULL AND (range_far_feet IS NULL OR range_far_feet >= range_near_feet))
        )
      )
